title: Keystone band personnel and Carlos Franzetti's concerto
summary: The band included Ponce, Steve Bailey and pianist Carlos Franzetti, who contributed tunes and wrote him the Jimmy and I clarinet concerto.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: For that second record, was that same band with Claudio?
Claudio, eh, Danielle Ponce on percussion, a bassist from Miami called Steve Bailey, and Carlos Franzetti was the pianist.
And what was the repertoire, was it your music?

Some of my music compositions, but by Chucho Valdés also, and some composition by Carlo Francetti, who was a great composer. This piano player from Argentina, a very talented player, but he is also a very Bill Evans oriented player, but he is also a good composer and arranger. He wrote a clarinet concerto for me, called the Jimmy and I Concerto because he was born June 3rd and I was born June 4th, the same year. So he wrote the Jimmy and I Concerto for me that I premier here in New York.
